lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a semi-regular grid; anterior clusters proximal to the gills show higher spatial frequency and smaller diameters, while mid-lateral blobs are larger with increased inter-centroid distance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible on the mid-lateral flank, intersecting with vertical columns of circular blobs to create a coordinate-like grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features are present across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient where high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side transition abruptly to shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, uniform high-luminance spots that are distinct from the larger, more spaced patterning found on the main body flank.
